image_description: A close-up, slightly angled view of a laminated restaurant menu. The menu features colorful illustrations of food dishes (including what appears to be curry or stew) alongside text descriptions and prices. The text is heavily distorted and illegible, appearing as gibberish characters rather than coherent words. There are reflections on the glossy surface of the menu.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The most critical failure. All text intended to be item names and prices is rendered as nonsensical, alien-like symbols or melted characters. This is a hallmark AI artifact.
The food items have a smeared, painterly quality that lacks realistic texture. Edges between the food illustrations and the white background bleed into each other.
The geometric lines of the menu page warp and curve unnaturally, suggesting a failure in maintaining rigid planar geometry.

alignment_reasoning: The image superficially resembles a menu due to the presence of food illustrations and a laminated look. However, it fails the core functional definition of a menu: providing readable information. The complete absence of legible text and structured layout means it does not fulfill the class requirements beyond a vague visual approximation.
artifact_reasoning: The image suffers from catastrophic text generation failure (gibberish), which is the primary artifact. The severity of the text artifact alone drastically reduces the quality score, as it renders the object functionally useless.
